findings.summary: Post-submit confirmations are rendered as populated status regions on the redirected page, so assistive technology may not announce that the payment request or read-state change succeeded.
findings.fix: After redirect, move focus to the confirmation or populate a status region already present in the page shell; keep the confirmation text in page content.
findings.evidence: Conditional role=status elements render a session flash after it is read and unset.

findings.summary: Payment errors appear in a newly rendered alert after submission without focus being moved to the error summary, so the error may not be announced or encountered promptly.
findings.fix: Move focus to the existing error summary or first invalid field after an unsuccessful submission while preserving field-level descriptions and invalid states.
findings.evidence: The conditional role=alert had tabindex=-1, but no focus management was shown in scope.

passed: Unread counts are included in the notification navigation link's accessible name, and the visual badge is hidden from assistive technology as duplicate content.
Fee reminders and payment-status notifications persist and render readable titles, messages, timestamps, and types.
